reanimator.summary: A mad-science Artificer who stitches an undead servant from corpses and shocks the fallen back to life.

Reanimator Spells.summary: Always prepared: False Life, Spare the Dying and Witch Bolt at Artificer 3; Blindness/Deafness and Enhance Ability at 5; Animate Dead and Lightning Bolt at 9; Blight and Death Ward at 13; Antilife Shell and Raise Dead at 17.

Reanimator’s Skill Set.summary: Spare the Dying can jolt its target back with HP equal to your Artificer level and zap chosen creatures within 10 ft (DEX save, 2d4 Lightning, half on success; 3d4 at 11, 4d4 at 17), INT-mod times per Long Rest. Proficiency with Alchemist’s Supplies, or another Artisan’s Tool if you have it.

options.name: Jolt to Life
options.summary: When casting Spare the Dying: target heals your Artificer level in HP; chosen creatures in a 10-ft Emanation around it make a DEX save or take 2d4 Lightning (half on success), rising to 3d4 at 11 and 4d4 at 17. INT-mod uses per Long Rest.

options.name: Reanimator’s Tools
options.summary: Trained in Alchemist’s Supplies, or a different Artisan’s Tool when already trained.

Reanimated Companion.summary: Magic action with Artisan’s Tools: build a Medium Undead companion (AC 10 + INT, HP 5 + 5× Artificer level, Dreadful Swipe 1d4 + INT Necrotic that stops Opportunity Attacks; explodes for 2d4 Necrotic on death, DEX save). It lasts until a Long Rest, dodges unless you spend a Bonus Action to command it; once per Long Rest or by spending a spell slot.

Strange Modifications.summary: Each companion you create gets one modification, chosen when you make it.

options.name: Arcane Conduit
options.summary: Cast spells from the companion’s space (using your own senses); once per turn add INT to one damage roll of an Artificer Evocation or Necromancy spell while it is within 120 ft.

Improved Reanimation.summary: The companion’s Death Burst deals 4d4, and its Necrotic damage ignores Resistance.

Macabre Modifications.summary: Your companion now takes two modifications, and three new ones join the list.

options.name: Bloated
options.summary: Companion becomes Large; Dreadful Swipe pushes a Large or smaller target up to 10 ft, and Death Burst adds your INT to its damage.

options.name: Gaunt
options.summary: Speed 45 ft with an equal Climb Speed (ceilings too, no checks); chosen creatures starting their turn within 10 ft make a WIS save or are Frightened until their next turn starts.

options.name: Moist
options.summary: Swim Speed equal to its Speed and squeezes through 1-inch gaps freely; attackers that hit it from within 10 ft take Acid damage equal to your INT.

Refined Reanimation.summary: Cast Raise Dead free once per Long Rest with tools as focus; Reaction to drain your companion for HP; companions now take three modifications.

options.name: Facilitated Revival
options.summary: Cast Raise Dead without a slot or Material components, using Artisan’s Tools as the focus; once per Long Rest.

options.name: Life Transfer
options.summary: Reaction when you or the companion take damage: gain HP equal to its current HP, then it dies and triggers Death Burst.

options.name: Superior Modifications
options.summary: Each companion gets three Strange Modifications.
